Sample a 2D level set as a polygon in one call

level_set_polygon_2d.Rd

Compound convenience: same result as level_set_2d followed by level_set_to_polygon, without passing the intermediate named list across the C boundary.

Usage

level_set_polygon_2d(
  ideal_x,
  ideal_y,
  utility_level,
  loss_config = make_loss_config(),
  dist_config = make_dist_config(),
  n_samples = 64L
)

Arguments

ideal_x, ideal_y

Ideal point coordinates.

utility_level

Target utility level (same as level_set_2d).

loss_config

Loss configuration from make_loss_config.

dist_config

Distance configuration from make_dist_config.

n_samples

Integer. Sample count for smooth shapes; ignored for polygon level sets (Manhattan / Chebyshev). Default: 64.

Value

Numeric matrix (n_pts × 2) with columns x and y.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
lc <- make_loss_config(loss_type = "linear", sensitivity = 1)
dc <- make_dist_config(distance_type = "euclidean", weights = c(1, 1))
poly <- level_set_polygon_2d(1, -0.5, utility_level = -0.5, lc, dc, n_samples = 32L)
plot(poly, type = "l", asp = 1)
} # }
